prompt: RFC 1035 resolver SLIST address no history round trip time
answer: For an SLIST address with no history, RFC 1035 specifies an expected round-trip time of **5–10 seconds in the worst case**, with **lower estimates for addresses on the same local network**. History is maintained per resolver-address/server-address pair.
